english.title: Remote pilot / UAS operator of unmanned aircraft fail to provide information / documentation / evidence upon request

english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 5(5) and (6) of Schedule 9 to the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Paragraph 10 of Schedule 9 to the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021 provides a defence to this offence.
(ii) Schedule 1 to the Air Navigation Order 2016 provides the meaning of 'remote pilot', 'UAS operator' and 'unmanned aircraft'.
(iii) Article 3 of the ANO 2016 provides the meaning of 'flight'.
(iv) 'Specified description' means a description specified by the Secretary of State by regulations for the purposes of paragraph 4 of Schedule 9 to the ATMUAA 2021.
(v) The 'NPCC Counter Drones Team' supports and co-ordinates counter drones activity across UK policing. For advice and support from this team, please email Drones.Secretariat@met.police.uk.
